segments.cap: It's Friday night. Tomorrow you've got twenty kids, sixteen laser tag vests, and zero signed waivers.
You're asking the birthday mom to collect a waiver from every single parent.
Half of them haven't even opened the link.
And your new ref doesn't know where the field is.
Here's what that same Friday looks like in Rally.
Every guest gets their own waiver link, and you watch them come in.
Deposits collect themselves, and the booking goes green when the waivers are in.
Your crew gets the address, the time, and the gear list. Automatically.
Comment SATURDAY, and I'll send you the exact reminders we automate.
